title: SEO Specialist
description: A roadmap for technical and content SEO: search fundamentals, keyword research, on-page optimization, technical audits, analytics, and growth experiments.

tree.name: Search and SEO Foundations
tree.description: Understand how search engines crawl, index, rank, and evaluate pages through relevance, quality, links, and user experience.

children.name: Crawling, Indexing, and Ranking
children.description: Learn sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical URLs, page quality, search intent, SERP features, and ranking signals.

children.name: Keyword and Intent Research
children.description: Map user intent, topic clusters, search volume, difficulty, competitor pages, and content opportunities.

tree.name: Content and On-page SEO
tree.description: Create useful pages with strong structure, headings, internal links, metadata, schema, and conversion-oriented content.

children.name: Content Briefs and Publishing
children.description: Write briefs, outlines, title tags, meta descriptions, FAQs, internal links, and update plans for stale pages.

children.name: Structured Data and Internal Links
children.description: Use schema markup, breadcrumbs, product/article data, hub pages, anchor text, and crawl-friendly navigation.

children.name: Practice: Technical SEO Fix List
children.description: Audit crawlability, metadata, schema, internal links, Core Web Vitals, and prioritize fixes by impact.

tree.name: Technical SEO and Analytics
tree.description: Audit performance, index coverage, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, logs, redirects, and measurement pipelines.

children.name: Technical SEO Audits
children.description: Check page speed, mobile usability, redirects, duplicate content, canonicals, broken links, hreflang, and sitemap coverage.

children.name: Search Console and GA4
children.description: Track queries, impressions, clicks, CTR, landing pages, conversions, events, segments, and ranking experiments.

tree.name: Growth Experiments and Portfolio
tree.description: Prove SEO skill with audits, experiments, content calendars, dashboards, and measurable before/after results.

children.name: SEO Reporting
children.description: Create dashboards for organic traffic, conversions, index health, content decay, keyword groups, and experiment outcomes.

children.name: Project: SEO Audit and Growth Plan
children.description: Audit a real website, create keyword clusters, fix technical issues, publish content briefs, and report measurable impact.
